___comment: Dedicated fixture dir (NOT the shared tests/harness/fixtures/llm/ pool) — a sequence fixture is tried on EVERY llm.generate()/debate()/research() call across ALL fixtures in the loaded dir (packages/agent-harness-core/src/mock-llm.ts), so dropping this file into the shared pool would let it compete with council.json/ideal.json on every other spec that uses the default fixtures dir. helpers.ts documents exactly this hazard for fixturesDir. See tests/harness/council-plan-gate.spec.ts.

model.___comment: Minimal AI-SDK-level block. --mock-llm <dir> refuses to boot (exit 78) unless some file in the dir declares a {model:...} block (src/index.ts). This spec drives a PLAIN chat turn (not the /council slash command — see council-plan-gate.spec.ts for why), so this stream backs PIL's model-first classify call (auto-intercepted below by 'classify') and would back an actual assistant reply if one were needed.

stream.delta: (unused — the turn is intercepted by the auto-council gate before any reply)

sequence.___comment: Clarifier round-0 question generation (runClarification's tracedGenerate call). Empty array = zero clarify questions, which sets gateReady=true and breaks the clarify loop without a readiness-judge call.

sequence.text: {"problemStatement":"Add a harness E2E spec that asserts the council intent gate renders as the first card of a real /council run, before any debate spend.","constraints":["Deterministic — no live network calls, no timing races"],"successCriteria":["askcard-open fires with phase=council-setup","optionCount is 10 (6 intent kinds + 4 shape options)","the rendered card surfaces the Implement option"],"scope":"in-scope: the council-setup launch card. out-of-scope: driving the debate or the plan phases."}
sequence.___comment: inferSpecFromTopicOnly's spec-synthesis call — fires because the clarifier asked zero questions (qa.length === 0).

sequence.text: {"needsResearch": false, "reason": "A self-contained harness spec does not require codebase research."}
sequence.___comment: evaluateResearchNeed's leader call. Does not gate reaching council-setup (research only runs inside the debate, which starts after the card), but a well-formed answer keeps the fixture honest.

sequence.text: {"intentSummary":"Add an E2E harness spec proving the council intent gate renders before any debate spend.","stances":[{"name":"Primary Engineer","lens":"Drive the real launch-card flow through the mock LLM deterministically."},{"name":"Skeptical Reviewer","lens":"Stress-test whether the assertion would actually catch a regression in the intent gate."}],"outputShape":{"kind":"implementation_plan","sections":[{"key":"steps","heading":"Steps","prompt":"ordered implementation steps","shape":"list"}],"guardrails":["Keep the spec deterministic — no live network calls."]}}
sequence.___comment: planDebate's RETRY attempt (tracedGenerate via llm.generate). Attempt 1 always fails here: it calls generateObject directly against the AI-SDK mock (not this sequence), whose doGenerate defaults to '{}' with no 'generate' field configured on the model block above, and '{}' fails DebatePlanSchema validation. outputShape.kind='implementation_plan' makes the Implement option the RECOMMENDED (first) intent option, which is what the spec asserts against render_text().

sequence.text: Council acknowledged — generic fallback for any remaining calls.
sequence.___comment: Safety net if an unaccounted-for call consumes the sequence past entry 4 — matches council.json's convention. The council-setup card is built purely from debatePlan (no further LLM calls), so this should never actually be reached.
